variable.name: LumenSkinSettingHelp
variable.value: Kids mode shows only the titles chosen in the Cinémathèque app. Set a PIN to show the Kids button on Home; leaving kids mode asks for it.
Asks for the current PIN, then removes it and hides the Kids button.[CR][CR]To change the PIN, remove it and set a new one.
Shows or hides this row on Home.[CR][CR]Kids mode keeps its own rows.
Adds a row at the end of Home from a smart playlist you pick, then asks for its name. Up to three.[CR][CR]Not shown in kids mode.
Changes the row's name on Home.
Takes the row off Home. The playlist itself stays.
Opens Kodi's video playlists. Choose "New smart playlist…", pick Movies or TV shows and the rules (for example Genre is Documentary), then save it and add it here.
Slowly zooms the backdrop on Home, library and detail pages.[CR][CR]Looks great, but the whole screen redraws every frame: on a Raspberry Pi menus drop to about half the frame rate. Off by default.
